activityManager.title: Activity Manager
activityManager.shortDescription: Web platform for managing and participating in activities. Users can explore and register for activities, organizers can create and manage them, and administrators have full management capabilities over users and activities.
activityManager.description: Activity Manager is a full stack application designed to centralize the creation, management, and participation in activities. Users can browse available activities and register for those they are interested in. Organizers have tools to create and manage their activities, while the administrator role has general control over the platform, including user and activity management. The solution uses Nuxt and Vue on the frontend, a REST API developed with Node.js and Express, and MongoDB Atlas as the database through Mongoose. In addition, an event-driven architecture using Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda was incorporated to automate processes and generate activity-related reminders.

features.explore: Exploration of available activities by users
features.userManagement: Complete user management by the administrator
features.activityManagement: Complete activity management by the administrator
features.api: REST API for communication between frontend and backend
features.eventBridge: Scheduled process execution using Amazon EventBridge

aventones.title: Aventones
aventones.shortDescription: Web application inspired by transportation platforms such as Uber, where users can search for available rides, drivers can publish and manage their trips, and administrators manage the overall operation of the system.
aventones.description: Aventones is a ride management web application developed with Laravel and PostgreSQL. The platform has three main roles. Users can search for available rides from an origin to a destination, view driver and vehicle information along with associated fares, and request to participate in a ride. Drivers can register their personal information and vehicles, create specific trips, and accept or reject passenger requests. The administrator role allows management of the platform's overall operation, including users, drivers, vehicles, and trips, while keeping users' sensitive information protected.

features.search: Ride search by origin and destination
features.fares: Display of fares associated with each ride
features.vehicleManagement: Vehicle registration and management by drivers
features.tripManagement: Trip creation and administration by drivers
features.requestManagement: Acceptance or rejection of passenger requests
features.adminManagement: General management of users, drivers, vehicles, and trips by the administrator
